source.git_provenance: First persisted by this append-only task-branch amendment; original in-chat instruction has no pre-existing repository SHA
source.scope: Existing Stage02 M1–M5 semantics only; not new game/Setter/collector authorization

learning_cycle.condition: Existing or future authorized unified Reader, Native Getter, Player Card or Game Log, with exact save/build/mode/source/time; unknown fields remain UNKNOWN
learning_cycle.action: Read evidence; do not synthesize unavailable native advanced metric

learning_cycle.condition: Inputs, field evidence axes, competing hypotheses and permitted metrics known
learning_cycle.action: Return NO_CHANGE, NEED_EVIDENCE, EXPERIMENT_PROPOSAL or AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED; do not equate proposal with permission

learning_cycle.condition: Separately authorized exact target, build, safe save, isolated one-factor setter and rollback
learning_cycle.action: Execute native setter only when authorized; independent immediate readback/invariant checks; retain failures

learning_cycle.condition: Gameplay/simulation takes place in later separately authorized or ordinary play context
learning_cycle.action: Treat 3D_CPU_CPU, CALENDAR_SIM, USER_VS_CPU as distinct strata

learning_cycle.condition: Future connected existing unified collector is separately implemented, validated and authorized
learning_cycle.action: Append game-computed native per-game/advanced stats first; never claim a scheduler or collector runs in Stage02

learning_cycle.condition: S0 and S2 source/provenance comparable, confounders and predeclared metric definitions checked
learning_cycle.action: Report SUPPORTS, REFUTES or INCONCLUSIVE/NEED_EVIDENCE with uncertainty; correlation not assumed causation

learning_cycle.condition: Compare new evidence against prior hypothesis and dissenting observations
learning_cycle.action: Append hypothesis revision/counterevidence and preserve earlier immutable facts; recommend next bounded experiment if useful

evidence_maturity_policy.rule: Per-field, per-mode and per-game-build promotion only after matching Native source and independent controls. Never require 204 fields pre-proven for use of sufficiently evidenced features; never promote an unknown by aggregation or confidence narrative.
evidence_maturity_policy.runtime_safety: Unknown or blocked mechanisms may yield research/expt suggestions but no unauthorised setting change. If no permission, source, independent readback or counterfactual comparability: NO_CHANGE / NEED_EVIDENCE.
evidence_maturity_policy.causal_guard: Observed correlations support/rebut an operational hypothesis; not by themselves validated causal laws.
evidence_maturity_policy.immutable_history: New observations, failed reads, REFUTES, INCONCLUSIVE, correction links and hypotheses must append, not replace old raw facts.

human_supplement.graph_interpretation: Directed hypothesis edges are not runtime setter routes. New gameplay evidence can revise a relationship or record counterevidence, not silently replace its original source grade.
